name: easen
description: Ask ChatGPT about your meetings, decisions and commitments, from your own Easen records.

interface.longDescription:
Easen sits beside your calls on your Mac or in the browser and keeps a record of each meeting: a summary, the decisions, who promised what, and the transcript. No bot joins the call, and live audio isn't saved.

This plugin lets ChatGPT read those records. So instead of digging through notes, you can ask "What did we agree with Northwind about the security review?" or "What do I owe people this week?" and ChatGPT answers from your own meetings, naming the ones it used.

You can search meetings by topic, person or date, open a meeting's decisions, read a transcript word for word, or list what's still open on both sides. If you turn on Live meeting access in Easen, ChatGPT can also follow a meeting while it's happening. That setting stays off until you turn it on, interviews are never shared, and live data is deleted two hours after the meeting ends.

Everything is read-only. ChatGPT only sees your own account and can't change or delete anything. You sign in with OAuth, and you can cut access anytime in Easen's Settings.
defaultPrompt: Use Easen to tell me what we agreed in my last meeting.
Use Easen to list what I owe people this week.
